# Fingertip

Fingertip is an all-in-one platform that enables businesses to manage their operations from a single link, offering tools for selling products, booking clients, and connecting with customers across various social media platforms.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/fingertip/.

## Actions

- **Create Fingertip Site**: Create a new Fingertip site.
- **Get Site Membership** (read-only): Retrieve site membership details.
- **Health Check** (read-only): Verify API connectivity.
- **List Event Types** (read-only): List event types for a specific site.
- **List Form Templates** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of form templates.
- **Delete Fingertip Site**: Delete a Fingertip site.
- **Delete Site Membership**: Delete a specific site membership.
- **Delete Workspace Invitation**: Delete a workspace invitation by its ID.
- **Get Comprehensive Site Analytics** (read-only): Retrieve comprehensive analytics for a specific site.
- **List Fingertip Blog Posts** (read-only): List published blog posts for a specific site.
- **List Page Themes** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of page themes.
- **List Pages** (read-only): List pages.
- **List Site Memberships** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of site memberships.
- **List Sites** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of sites accessible by the API key.
- **List Workspaces** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of workspaces accessible to the API key.
